arabic text: FATIMA KI LASH PAR HASNAIN AS KARTY THAY BUKAA
english translation text: HASAN AND HUSSAIN WERE CRYING AT THE BODY OF FATIMA (S.A.)

arabic text: AMMAA'N ZAHRA SA KAM SINI ME'N YU'N NA RUUTHOO AMMAA'N\nAMMAA'N ZAHRA SA AANKHAI'N KHOOLO KUCH TO BOLO AMMAA’N
english translation text: OH MOTHER! PLEASE OPEN YOUR EYES AND SAY\nSOMETHING. WE ARE YOUNG PLEASE DON’T BE UPSET

arabic text: HAM TARASTY HAI'N SADAA AAYGI MAADAR KI HAMAI'N\nMERY BACCHOO'N MERY PIAAROO'N KUCH TO BOOLO AMMAA'N
english translation text: WE ARE EAGERLY WAITING FOR YOUR REPLY OH MOTHER! PLEASE SAY\n'MY LOVE, MY DEAR KIDS'

arabic text: KHAALI BISTER KO TERY TAKTAY HAI'N HAM HASRAT SAY\nRAAT BHAR KAY HAM HAI'N JAAGAY TUM SULAAO AMMAA'N
english translation text: WITH GRIEF, WE ARE LOOKING AT YOUR EMPTY BED. OH MOTHER, PLEASE\nCOME PUT US TO BED, WE HAVE BEEN UP ALL NIGHT

arabic text: HAAL KYAA HOGAYA DEKHO ZARA ROOTAY ROOTAY\nHAM KO SEENAY SAY LAGAAO CHUP KARAAAO AMMAA'N
english translation text: LOOK AT OUR CONDITION AND WEEP\nPLEASE COME TO COMFORT US, OH MOTHER

arabic text: KON AB PIAAR KARY GAA YE BATAAO AMMAA'N\nKON AB PIAAR SAY CHUUMAY GAA HAMARAA MAATHA
english translation text: WHO WILL KISS OUR FOREHEADS NOW?\nWHO WILL LOVE US LIKE YOU, OH MOTHER?

arabic text: TUM NAY MANGWAAYE THAY JANNAT SAY HAMARY JO LIBAAS\nAAJ PHIR HAATHOO'N SAY APNY WO PINHAAO AMMAA'N
english translation text: PLEASE DRESS US IN THE CLOTHES\nWHICH YOU RECEIVED FROM HEAVEN.

arabic text: ARSALAAN AZMI ROOTAY RAHAY CHAAROO'N BACCHAY\nOR KEHTAY RAHAY MAT CHOOR KAY JAAO AMMAA'N
english translation text: THE FOUR CHILDREN WERE CRYING,\n'PLEASE DON’T LEAVE US MOTHER!'
